cases.task: Given a list of integers nums and an integer target, return the two distinct indices i and j such that nums[i] + nums[j] == target. Assume exactly one solution exists. Constraints: 2 <= len(nums) <= 10^4. Example: nums = [2, 7, 11, 15], target = 9 returns [0, 1].

cases.task: Given a list of integers nums and an integer target, return True if two distinct elements sum to target, and False otherwise. Constraints: 0 <= len(nums) <= 10^5. Example: nums = [8, 1, 4], target = 5 returns True.
